utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I can grab a couple of the missing things for the repair drive. Just tell me what’s still left.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Mina and Sam are coordinating it, and Mara’s got the screwdriver set and duct tape already. Sam said he’d send any new repair requests over to Mara.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — sounds like the screwdriver set and duct tape are covered. If there are still flashlights or spare screws left, I can pick up a couple of those.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, we’re at 10 for the repair drive, and I’ve got Oren down for the screwdriver set and duct tape. I’m also keeping the volunteer sign-ups and who can handle which repairs.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds good — I’ve got Ira spreading the word while he’s out, Jules checking the community center for donated tools, and Rosa telling Cleo the tools and Vik’s help are on the way.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect — I’ll log Ira, Jules, and Rosa’s updates, and I’ll keep tracking who can handle each repair. With us at 10, the drive’s coming together nicely.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, the repair drive’s still at 9 over at the community center. I’ll check for the donated tools there and bring them by.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Nice, I’m bringing some batteries and a box or two too. Might also grab a couple flashlights if I spot them.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, that’ll help a lot. I’ll grab the donated tools at the community center and head over right after.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands. The repair drive is at 3 PM at the community center, right?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yep, 3 PM at the community center. I can bring a hammer, screwdrivers, and some spare nails.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep, that’s the one. I’ll keep listening while I’m out running errands and see if anyone else has gear to bring.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got the tape and gloves covered. Noah can help with whatever’s still missing, like those flashlights.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, but can you confirm the time and place for the repair drive? I’ll come once that’s settled.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I don’t have the time and place yet, but I’m checking with Bo now. I’ll let you know as soon as I’ve got it settled.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Rey can help with the repair drive, too. We’re still short on screwdrivers, spare screws, and a few rolls of duct tape, but Dane and Nell are already pitching in.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, that helps a lot. I’m still gathering tools and parts, and I still need a drill, a step ladder, and a couple extension cords.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll keep an ear out for a drill, a step ladder, and some extension cords too. With Rey, Dane, and Nell helping, we’re getting this repair drive in good shape.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, with Rey, Vik, and Dane helping, we’re in good shape. Vik can bring the hammer, screwdrivers, and spare nails too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’ll stay in touch with Mina and keep the repair drive on track.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks — keep me posted if Mina needs anything else.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Happy to help with the repair drive—what time are we meeting, and what should I haul first?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Let’s meet at 9 by the curb, and if you can start with the boxes and the small dresser, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—9 by the curb works for me. I’ll start with the boxes and the small dresser.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I brought my screwdriver set and a roll of duct tape for the repair drive. Hope that helps a bit.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That helps a lot, Oren. I’m still gathering a few things, and if anything’s missing, Noah can help fill in the gaps.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Glad to help. If you still need anything small, I can check my shed again after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Mara’s got the sign-ups and repair list handled, so we should know who’s best for each job. I heard Oren’s coming at 10 with his screwdriver set and duct tape.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh good, that’ll help a lot. I can ask around for spare screws, and I can bring screwdrivers and some duct tape too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’d be great, Nell. Mara should be able to slot everyone in where they’re most useful.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll sort the donations and make a quick list of what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, send me the time and list and I’ll pass it along fast. I’ll line up a few neighbors to help too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks — I’ll send the time and list over shortly.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yep, we’re still set for 3 PM at the community center. I’ll let Sam know, and Ira’s keeping an ear out too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, I’ll gather the names and addresses and sort them by street and urgency. Thanks for keeping Sam and Ira in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Perfect, thanks Rosa. I’ll keep Sam updated and see you at 3 PM by the community center.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can bring a hammer, screwdrivers, and some spare nails.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That’d be great, Dane — thank you. Mina and I are coordinating the repair drive, so I’ll let her know you’re bringing those.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’ll bring those by and check in when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So it’s at the community center, right? Just confirming the time and drop-off spot, and I can come once that’s settled.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, the drop-off spot is the community center. Once the time is settled, you can head there and bring anything you want to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it—community center, then. Just need the time confirmed, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: 3 PM at the community center still works for me. I’ll let Sam know.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, 3 PM at the community center still works. I’ll check for the donated tools and bring them over to the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Perfect, thanks, Jules. I’ll keep Sam posted and see you at 3 PM at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We're at 10 so far, and Oren said he'd bring a screwdriver set and duct tape at 10. I'm keeping the sign-ups and who can handle which repairs—want to help match folks to tasks?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes — I can sort the donations and make a quick list of what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That would be great — thanks, Leo. I’ll keep tracking the sign-ups and repairs, and you can note what’s still missing as the donations come in.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I can bring screwdrivers and duct tape, and I’ll ask around for spare screws too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s great, Nell. I’ll haul a few boxes and the small dresser, and Rey can sort the donations and keep an eye out for the drill, step ladder, and extension cords.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, that covers a lot. I’ll check with folks about the spare screws and bring the screwdrivers and duct tape.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ve got a few things together for the repair drive, and Bo’s batteries and boxes should help too. If we’re still short on anything, Noah can cover the rest.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll drop off the batteries and a box or two. If you still need anything else, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Bo. I’ll keep sorting what’s left and check with Mara on the sign-ups.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll confirm the drop-off time and check whether we still need extra boxes.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Hana — I’m still gathering tools and parts, so I’ll keep an eye out for a drill, a step ladder, and a couple extension cords.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, I’ll coordinate around the school schedule and keep things moving. We’ve got Rey and Dane helping, and I’ll wait on Hana to confirm the drop-off time and box needs.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got tape and gloves covered for the repair drive. If we’re still short, I can check on screwdrivers, spare screws, and a couple flashlights too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That would be really helpful, thanks. Vik can bring a hammer, some screwdrivers, and spare nails, so we should be in good shape once Hana confirms the drop-off time.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Rey can help with the repair drive, and Cleo said we’re still short on screwdrivers, spare screws, and a few rolls of duct tape. Dane can bring a hammer, screwdrivers, and some spare nails, and Eli still needs a drill, a step ladder, and a couple extension cords.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Tess — I’ll add Rey, and I’ll note the shortfalls too. I’m sorting the names and addresses by street and urgency for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands, and I’ll pass along anything useful I hear about the repair drive at 3 PM. Sounds like we’ve got the community center covered.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it — I’ll check the drop-off time and see if we still need extra boxes. Thanks for keeping an eye out for the drill, step ladder, and extension cords.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing — I’ll listen for any word on the drill, step ladder, or extension cords while I’m out. I’ll pass it along if I hear anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ll pass along Leo’s time and list fast, and I’ll spread the word to line up a few neighbors to help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn. That should help keep things moving smoothly for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Ira. I’ve got my screwdriver set and a roll of duct tape ready for the repair drive.
